title: Stationary spectral-sequence naturality extends through localization
statement: Let A be a category, W a morphism property, C an abelian category, E:W.Localization→CohomologicalSpectralSequence(C,1) and H:W.Localization→C functors. Fix (a,b), bounds B(X), and comparisons c(X,r):E(X)_r^(a,b)≅H(X) for r≥max(1,B(X)). Suppose the cycle inclusions at (a,b) are epic at these indices, the comparisons respect successor-page homology, and the naturality square for each original morphism commutes at all sufficiently large indices. Then the square E(α)_r c(Y,r)=c(X,r) H(α) commutes for every localized α:X→Y at every r≥max(1,B(X),B(Y)).

proof.text: Define eventual naturality as a morphism property. For composition take a common bound including the intermediate object bound. For inversion cancel the invertible page-evaluation maps and the maps in H. Mathlib Localization.Construction.morphismProperty_eq_top' extends eventual naturality from original maps and inverse isomorphisms to the entire localization.

Start at a sufficiently large index with the eventual square. Precompose the preceding-page square by the epic source-cycle inclusion. Naturality of cycles and homology, both successor equations and the spectral-sequence morphism equation reduce it to the next-page square. Cancel the epimorphism and induct on the finite difference of indices.
